resources.string: The app finds your computer on the same network and transfers files directly, without a cloud. The connection is always encrypted.
illustration: phone to computer, a lock
A file goes from the phone to the computer over your own network — no cloud, no one else\'s servers. You check the device key once; after that the connection is trusted.
Permissions are asked for inside the path you pick — and explained there.
